name: io.github.tonyyang0504/binance_cm-mcp
description: Binance COIN-M Futures (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles, get_balances, list_orde

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BINANCE_CM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Binance API key (sent as X-MBX-APIKEY). Create it under API Management with withdrawals OFF; restrict it to your IP. Futures testnet: create a key at https://testnet.binancefuture.com and point adapter.base_url there (testnet keys only work on the testnet host).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BINANCE_CM_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The key's HMAC secret: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the exact query string, appended as `signature` after `timestamp`). Never sent on the wire.
